S. 1, Special Branch Station. File No. ________________ Date March 11, 1942.

SUBJECT: Hopei Fellow Countrymen's Association and allegations against Soong Kwang Middle School (松光中学)

Wu Nien Ting (武宜停), chairman of the Hopei Fellow Countrymen's Association between July 1938 and March 1939, went to Tientsin in April 1939 without asking for leave from the Association. He returned to Shanghai at the beginning of February this year. On February 19, he sent a letter to the Association requesting to resume his position as chairman but the request was refused by the Association. On February 28, he sent another letter in which he alleged that the Soong Kwang Middle School, located on the upper portion of the Association, was of an anti-Japanese nature. He demanded a satisfactory reply to his request for resumption of the office of chairman, and stated that he would settle the matter by means of force, should he receive no satisfactory reply by March 3.

Wu Nien Ting declared that he had never resigned from the post of chairman of the Association and that his allegation against the Soong Kwang Middle School was based on the fact that anti-Japanese posters were found on the school premises about one year ago, and that the school changed its name from Soong Kiang (松江) to Soong Kwang after December 8. He, however, denied any intention to settle the dispute over the chairmanship by means of force.

主题：河北同乡会及针对松光中学的指控

武宜停（Wu Nien Ting），1938年7月至1939年3月期间担任河北同乡会主席，于1939年4月未向同乡会请假便前往天津。他于今年2月初返回上海。2月19日，他致函同乡会请求复任主席职务，但该请求被同乡会拒绝。2月28日，他发出另一封信，指控位于同乡会楼上的松光中学具有反日性质。他要求对其复职请求给予满意答复，并声明若在3月3日前未收到满意答复，他将采取武力手段解决此事。

武宜停声称他从未辞去同乡会主席一职，并称其对松光中学的指控基于以下事实：约一年前在校内发现反日海报，且该校在12月8日后由“松江”（Soong Kiang）更名为“松光”（Soong Kwang）。然而，他否认有任何通过武力解决主席职位争议的意图。

REPORT
Date May 3, 19 38

Subject Hopei Fellow Countrymen's Association - meeting.

Made by D.I. Pan Lien-pih Forwarded by C. Campbell

The Hopei Fellow Countrymen's Association, 46 Avenue
Foch, held a meeting in the Huchow Club, 263 Kweichow Road,
at 1 p.m. May 1, when some 150 persons attended. Mr. Chen
Tieh Sung(陳鉄生) and two others who presided delivered
speeches urging the attendance to join the association and
pay their membership fees. Entertainment in the form of
Peiping style dramas, "Pang Pang" dramas, sound mimicking,
and Chinese boxing took place during which nothing of a
political nature was mentioned.

Mr. Wu I Ting(武宜亭), who formed the subject of a
Special Branch report dated April 29, also attended and
delivered a speech on the intended improvement of conditions
in the association, but stressed that this could only be
achieved if peace was restored to this city and the removal of
all military forces. He asked for the support of the audience
in this project, and if forthcoming, would undertake the task
of endeavouring to have the troops leave Shanghai, and so
in this way would the association benefit.

The function terminated at 6.40 p.m.

The election of an executive committee to the association
which was scheduled to take place during the meeting, did not
materialize.

Pan Lien-pih
D. I.

D.C.(Special Branch)

日期 1938年5月3日

主题 河北同乡会 - 会议。

由 D.I. Pan Lien-pih 制作 由 C. Campbell 转呈

河北同乡会（福煦路46号）于5月1日下午1时在贵州路263号湖州会馆举行会议，约有150人出席。陈铁生（Chen Tieh Sung）及另外两位主持人发表演讲，敦促与会者加入该会并缴纳会费。期间上演了北平风格戏剧、“梆梆”戏、口技和中国武术等娱乐节目，过程中未提及任何政治性内容。

武宜亭（Wu I Ting），即4月29日特别部报告的主题人物，也出席了会议并发表演讲，谈及改善同乡会状况的计划，但强调只有恢复本市和平并撤走所有军队才能实现这一目标。他请求观众支持此计划，并表示若获支持，将致力于促使军队离开上海，从而使同乡会受益。

活动于下午6时40分结束。

原定于会议期间举行的同乡会执行委员会选举并未进行。

Pan Lien-pih
D. I.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Letter from Hopei Fellow Countrymen's Association, No. 46
Translation of Avenue Joffre.

April 25, 1938.

To
Police Department,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sirs,

We are experiencing pecuniary embarrassment caused by the maintenance of more than 300 refugees - fellow countrymen for three months after August 13, 1937, coupled with the fact that several cases of destitute fellow countrymen asking for relief continue to come to our attention daily. The source of our revenue depends on membership fees collected from members once a year, who will receive a membership card on payment of the membership fee. With this in view we have decided to call the annual meeting for membership on May 1, at 12 noon to 5 p.m. at the late Chen Chi Mei's Memorial Hall, Weichow Road, when Hopei actors etc. will participate in entertaining members in a vaudeville show and about 200 members are expected to attend the meeting.

We submit the foregoing for your consideration requesting you to be good enough to detail police officers to be present to accord protection to the meeting should the application be approved by you.

(Chopped): Hopei Fellow Countrymen's Association.

REPORT
Date February 28, 1938.

Subject The Hopei Fellow Countrymen's Association

Made by D.S.I. Shih Ssu-chien Forwarded by C. Clausen D.I.

With reference to the attached instructions of the
D.C. (Special Branch), Messrs. Sung Ying-sze (申應試) and
Wong Shao Siang (王宇光), responsible committee members
of the Hopei Fellow Countrymen's Association, 46 Avenue Foch,
were interviewed and the subject in question discussed.
According to the opinion of the above named persons, members
of the Association who are employees of the Dah Dao City
Government are very few in number, although at least one
third of the whole strength of the Dah Dao City Government
Police Bureau, which is estimated to be around 15,000 officers
and men, are believed to be natives of Hopei Province. As
far as the record of the Association can show, only two
persons named Dong Zeu Zee (董壽永) and Van Yue Ming
(范虞民) were former members of the Association, and
who subsequently withdrew from the Association shortly after
they had been appointed as Chief of the General Affairs
Department of the Dah Dao City Government and Chief of the
Chenju and Dazang Sub-Bureau of the Dah Dao Police Bureau,
respectively.

The registers of the Association also show that,
prior to the outbreak of the local hostilities, the Associa-
tion had about 800 members, out of which number, some 50
persons were connected with the former Shanghai City Govern-
ment Police Bureau. At present none of these persons have
attempted to renew their membership with the Association,
and their present whereabouts are unknown. Efforts to
ascertain if any of these persons have since joined the Dah
Dao City Government have so far been unsuccessful.

主题 河北同乡会

由 D.S.I. Shih Ssu-chien 制作 由 C. Clausen D.I. 转呈

参照特别部副主任的附件指示，对河北同乡会（福煦路46号）负责委员申應試（Sung Ying-sze）和王宇光（Wong Shao Siang）进行了面谈，并讨论了相关议题。据上述人士意见，虽然据信大道市政府警察局全体约15,000名官兵中至少有三分之一是河北籍，但在该会任职的大道市政府雇员人数极少。就同乡会记录显示，仅有董壽永（Dong Zeu Zee）和范虞民（Van Yue Ming）两人曾是该会会员，他们在分别被任命为大道市政府总务处处长和大道警察局陈菊与大藏分局局长后不久便退出了该会。

同乡会名册还显示，在当地战事爆发前，该会有约800名会员，其中约50人与前上海市政府警察局有关联。目前，这些人中无人试图 renew 其在同乡会的会籍，其当前下落不明。迄今为止，试图查明这些人中是否有任何人已加入大道市政府的努力均未成功。

countrymen of Hopei Province. It was registered with the
former local Tangpu and Bureau of Social Affairs, and an
official certificate was granted. It undertakes various

clinics and primary schools. The upkeep of the Association

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Regarding the remarks of the P.P. "A" Division,
C.D.S. 121 has made enquiries at the Hupeh Fellow
Countrymen's Guild, 46 Avenue Foch and checked on the
points raised.

Dong Hau Zee (董兆篯) and Van Tsong Liang (阮忠良),
the persons named in the threatening letter received have
been members of the above guild for over ten years, and
as far as can be ascertained, the feeling towards these
persons by other members of the guild, is quite friendly.

No persons were located who could give details of
any resentment felt towards the guild, due to their
employment by the Yu Tao Government, of which they did
not inform the guild, neither was anything ascertained
regarding enmity due to private reasons.

During their last visit to the guild they conversed
with various members of the guild, but this was not of
a political nature and gave no cause for ill feeling.

No other information was received during investi-
gations that would give any indication for the receipt
of the threatening letter, since which time, neither of
the threatened persons has attended the premises.

Whether the offence was committed from political
or private reasons has not yet been ascertained, but up
to the present no other letter or threats have been
made. Enquiries proceeding.

刑事侦缉警员第 121 号已在福煦路 46 号的湖北同乡会进行了查询，并核实了所提出的问题。

恐吓信中点名的董兆篯（Dong Hau Zee）和阮忠良（Van Tsong Liang），已是上述同乡会的会员超过十年，据查，同乡会其他会员对这两人的态度相当友好。

未能找到任何人能提供因该会同乡受雇于“大道政府”（Yu Tao Government，原文如此，应指大道市政府）且未告知同乡会而对该会产生怨恨的细节，也未查明任何因私人原因产生的敌意。

在他们最近一次访问同乡会期间，他们与会内多名成员进行了交谈，但谈话内容不涉及政治性质，也未引起恶感。

在调查过程中未收到其他任何能表明收到恐吓信原因的信息，自那以后，两名被威胁者均未再前往该处所。

该罪行是出于政治原因还是私人原因尚未查明，但截至目前，未再收到其他信件或威胁。查询正在进行中。

(Any outstanding or peculiar feature to be commented on by investigating officer). | At 1.30 p.m. on the 26/1/38 one Sih Bei Ziang
(周佩祥) a teaboy in the employ of the Hupeh Fellow
Countrymens' Guild, brought to the Station the
attached threatening letter which was delivered by
post to the Guilds' premises at 46, Avenue Foch at
4.30 p.m. on the 26/1/38.

A translation of the letter, which was written
in pen and ink, reads as follows:-

"Enquiries conducted by our group prove that the
Hupeh Fellow Countrymens' Guild is a place of
assembly for traitors.

Two of your members named Dong and Van, who
frequent your premises are employed by the Great
Way City' Government.

We have sent a cartridge case warning you to
eliminate activities of this nature.

Dong and Van should be particularly careful.

Traitors Elimination Group."

In connection with the foregoing it should be
mentioned that at 8.30 a.m. on the 23/1/38, C.P.C.s
discovered an empty pineapple type hand grenade
suspended from an electric light standard in front
of the Guilds' premises at the above address. Misc.
6/38. Ch. Rd.

At 9.00 a.m. on the 27/1/38 C.D.S. 121 and the
undersigned visited the Guild and interviewed the
two senior members named Voong Kyung Ding (敬亭)
and Tsang Wei San (張蔚山), from whom the following
was ascertained. |

这封用钢笔墨水书写的信的译文如下：

“经本团调查证实，湖北同乡会是汉奸聚集之地。

贵会两名经常出入贵处的成员董某和阮某，受雇于‘大道市政府’。

我方寄去弹壳一枚，警告你们消除此类活动。

董、阮二人应格外小心。

锄奸团。”

鉴于上述情况，需提及的是，1938 年 1 月 23 日上午 8:30，中央巡逻队（C.P.C.s）在上述地址同乡会场所前的电灯杆上发现了一枚悬挂着的空菠萝型手榴弹。杂项案 6/38。成都路。

1938 年 1 月 27 日上午 9:00，刑事侦缉警员第 121 号及签署人走访了该同乡会，并面谈了两名资深成员敬亭（Voong Kyung Ding，音译）和張蔚山（Tsang Wei San），从中获悉以下情况。 |
